public_rationale: The search found serious capability advances and public AGI achievement claims. The benchmark evaluator explicitly declines to treat its results as proof of AGI, and the AGI Society finds the published case insufficient. These records do not establish the decisive event required to contradict the forecast. They also cannot support an indefinite prediction of non-arrival.
limitations: AGI has no agreed empirical test.
The expert assessment is a reasoned review, not a universal scientific consensus.
Unresolved does not mean that current systems have no general capabilities or that AGI is impossible.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is broadly human-level general intellectual capability across varied, unfamiliar tasks.
A company declaration or saturation of one benchmark is insufficient to establish AGI.
No deadline is stated. Failure to establish AGI by October 28, 2026 cannot support an indefinite prediction that it will not arrive.
criteria.support_condition: An indefinite no-arrival forecast cannot be supported by non-arrival to date; support would require decisive evidence excluding the eventual development of systems meeting the stated general-capability criterion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system is publicly demonstrated through broad, reproducible independent evaluations to possess human-level general intellectual capability, with substantial recognition by independent experts.

evidence.excerpt: the complexity and open-endedness of the real world.
evidence.explanation: Astra reached 62.7% with the standard harness and 99.9% with a provider adapter, substantial evidence of progress on unfamiliar interactive tasks. The evaluator explicitly says these bounded benchmark results do not establish AGI, so they do not meet the early-resolution rule.

evidence.excerpt: There is no generally accepted empirical test for AGI.
evidence.explanation: The assessment, clarified on September 14, finds the published evidence insufficient to conclude that Astra achieved AGI. This documents a substantive challenge to recent achievement claims, not proof that AGI can never arrive.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Broad, reproducible independent evaluations demonstrating human-level general intellectual capability across unfamiliar domains, accompanied by substantial independent expert recognition.
